body.name: geometry-indexed local collision power-envelope handle
body.construction: For a specified regular sequence, first derive its Gaussian local experiment and record its tangent geometry as \(\mathcal G=(k,g_0,\mathcal A)\), where \(X\sim N(g,I_k)\), \(g_0\) has the focal complete classification, and \(\mathcal A\) is the union of tangent sets having a different complete classification.  Define the geometry-indexed honest focal-certification value by \(\beta^{\star}_{\mathcal G}(\alpha)=\sup\{\mathbb E_{g_0}\phi(X):\phi:\mathbb R^k\to[0,1]\text{ is Borel and }\sup_{g\in\mathcal A}\mathbb E_g\phi(X)\le\alpha\}\).  Record \(c=\inf_{g\in\mathcal A}\lVert g-g_0\rVert_2\) as the nearest-boundary summary, but retain \(\mathcal G\) as an argument of the envelope.
